semantics.note: The proposition preserves the retrospective comparison of demonstrated IMO performance in 2024 and 2025.

contract.note: Higher medal performance with less preprocessing and shorter solving time is an ordinary reading of progress in this context. The contract appropriately excludes statistical significance and controlled capability measurement.

evidence.note: The researchers' peer-reviewed account establishes the 2024 baseline: silver-level performance, expert formalization and multi-day computation. Publication precedes the evaluation cutoff; this remains a report of their own system.

Reports the 2025 gold-standard score and confirmation through IMO grading. The packet also describes natural-language operation within the time limit, attributed to researchers; those operational details are company disclosures.

reviews.rationale: The packet documents improvement from silver-level performance requiring expert translation and days of computation to gold-standard performance with natural-language operation within the contest limit. Different annual problems limit controlled comparisons but do not defeat this ordinary reading of demonstrated progress.
